notes: S3.4 incorrectly states that the counter holds whenever it is at a boundary, without coupling the boundary to the requested direction. At maximum with en high and up low, the counter must decrement; at zero with en high and up high, it must increment. Saturation applies only to an increment at maximum or a decrement at minimum. S2.3 had already expressed the direction-sensitive guards correctly, so S3.4 is the earliest substantive process error. The final RTL retains the correct direction-sensitive boundary logic and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
